label: Left at a stop with no foul, timeout, turnover or violation logged
explain: Often the referees stopping play for a hurt player.

label: The only player the team took out
explain: Coaches often sub in groups; an injury takes one player out alone.

label: A teammate shot the free throws for a foul the player drew
explain: The player couldn't stay in to shoot them.

label: Left at the team's own timeout
explain: Teams call timeout to get a hurt player off.

label: Committed a take foul to stop play
explain: Not a cause: a hurt player commits a take foul to stop play and get off the floor.

label: Lost the ball or traveled
explain: Probably what the injury looks like: an ankle rolls or a muscle grabs mid-dribble and the ball goes. Early exits with no injury after them show it too, less often.
